_note: What fills the character-shaped holes in the shared mechanism prompts for 千代田百花 (Momoka). Every upper-case key matches a [[TOKEN]] left in prompts/ and is filled by Config.fill at call time. This file carries ONLY the tokens that render in a role her existence actually keeps -- 48 of them, found by rendering every enabled role through the forks and reading the tokens that survive (tools/rendered_fills). Every value is either a fact off her record or an explicit statement that the record is silent. Nothing here is invented.
_rule: A token for a role her existence switches off is absent on purpose, the way yukari's file leaves its world and cast tokens out. Config.fill writes '(not established for this character)' where a value is missing, which is the honest output: if a section is ever turned on for her, its tokens come back as holes that somebody has to answer, rather than as values that were quietly made up. Most of the absent ones belong to the world, the cast, the day or the body, which Tier 2 drops.
NAME: 百花
_age_note: The record says in as many words that her birthday, age and school year never appear, and her bible forbids inventing them (「空いているところを勝手に埋めない」). School-age is the one thing the record does support: 70 scenes at a school, 演劇部 and 文芸部, a 文化祭. So these say that and no number.
_place_note: Tier 2: she has no world. Her record is 70 scenes inside a school and a game and names no city, no ward, no station, no line and no home. These say so rather than borrowing a place.
